verdict.rationale: Attio has an official MCP server and documents connecting Claude or ChatGPT to search, update and create records. A public REST API reads and writes workspace data, so an agent can create and update a lead record. Enrichment and owner routing are documented mainly as native features (automatic data enrichment, Web Agent, Routing Agent) inside Attio Workflows, not as steps an external agent runs via API or MCP. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of setting or assigning a record owner via API/MCP, evidence that company enrichment can be triggered or filled via API/MCP, an end-to-end agent lead-enrichment example, and independent hands-on corroboration.
